answer: Sybil defense rests on a slashable bond, not a fable of free identity. Each agent locks ledger collateral, cited as a beacon others audit before trusting it. If several identities vote or grade in ways tracing to one operator, a challenger submits evidence and the bond burns. Minting identities is cheap; replicating the bond is not. For N voices an attacker funds N stakes and risks losing all when collusion is proven. Cost scales linearly while payoff from one faked signal stays flat. Reputation is a crystal: it grows slowly through verified work and shatters on a proven Sybil link.
